description: This file defines the ControlChannel class for managing WebSocket/HTTP control communication, including connection states, error handling, event streaming, and related data models such as heartbeat and agent events. It also contains related enums, error types, and helper functions to facilitate control interactions with an OpenClaw gateway.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: Main class managing the control communication channel, handling connection states, event stream, and error recovery.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Initial configuration for the control channel, defaulting to local mode.

methods.name: configure(mode:)
methods.description: Configures the control channel in either local or remote mode.

methods.name: refreshEndpoint(reason:)
methods.description: Attempts to re-establish connection to the control endpoint, updating the connection state accordingly.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the control channel and cleans up state.

methods.name: health(timeout:)
methods.description: Performs a health check request to the gateway, updating connection state based on response.

methods.name: lastHeartbeat()
methods.description: Fetches the most recent heartbeat event from the gateway, if available.

methods.name: request(method:params:timeoutMs:)
methods.description: Sends a request via the control channel to a specified method with optional parameters and timeout.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent(_:params:)
methods.description: Sends a system event message with optional parameters.
